Title: 503504-2026: France – Civil and structural engineering works – Design and construction of the structural strengthening of 8 viaducts on the A8 motorway, Roquebrune - Italian border section.
Agent_1: {"relevancy_score":6,"relevancy_explanation":"Relevant contract, as it concerns repair/strengthening works on several road viaducts (a typical sbp topic). Deduction because the contract is awarded outside Germany and as a combined tender for 8 bridges, which is less attractive for us."}
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Relevant contract, as it concerns repair/strengthening works on several road viaducts (a typical sbp topic). Deduction because the contract is awarded outside Germany and as a combined tender for 8 bridges, which is less attractive for us.
titel: Design and execution of the structural strengthening of 8 viaducts on the A8 motorway, Roquebrune - Italian border section
kurzbeschreibung: Design and execution for the strengthening of eight motorway viaducts on the A8.
umfang: Design-and-build contract for the structural strengthening of a total of 8 road viaducts on the A8 in the municipalities of Gorbio, Sainte-Agnès and Menton. Lot 1 comprises Rank Nord approx. 360 m, Rank Sud approx. 360 m, Gorbio Sud approx. 152 m and Pala Sud approx. 190 m. Lot 2 comprises Baousset Sud approx. 104 m, Garavan Sud approx. 184 m, Baousset Nord approx. 104 m and Garavan Nord approx. 184 m. Measures in particular: strengthening by external additional prestressing, resulting structural strengthening, repair in accordance with the latest principal inspections, and partial renewal of expansion joints.
leistungen: Design and construction execution in a design-build model. Includes taking over and deepening the preliminary investigations, confirmation DIAG E0, final diagnosis, preparation of the APROA and PRO documents, as well as execution of the strengthening and repair works on the viaducts; per lot with basic tranche and optional tranches.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Very good technical fit with sbp due to bridge and viaduct construction with an explicit design component.
• Not only construction work, but design-build with required design and diagnostic services; therefore strategically relevant design involvement.
• Technically interesting due to strengthening of existing road viaducts by means of external prestressing and complex interventions in existing structures under ongoing motorway traffic.
• Several structures in one procedure increase market opportunities and visibility in the French infrastructure sector.
• Road bridges are generally relevant for sbp, especially for demanding structural and repair tasks.
• Slightly lower rating because the focus is strongly on construction execution and execution-related qualifications and no exceptionally large spans are mentioned.
• France is in principle a relevant European market for sbp.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs are stated in the tender. A reliable estimate is not possible due to the lack of information on cross-sections, extent of damage, quantities of prestressing, scope of concrete repair, traffic management and construction phases. However, 8 viaducts with total lengths of around 1,638 m are known, as well as measures such as external additional prestressing, repair and partial replacement of expansion joints; from this only a very rough estimate of a medium to high double-digit million volume can be derived.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee specified. As this is a design-build contract, a separate design fee for structural design cannot be derived from the notice. Relevant factors would be the number of structures, diagnostics, APROA and PRO documents, construction phases under traffic, and the scope of the strengthening measures.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Minimum turnover: Lot 1 annual 3,000,000 euros, Lot 2 annual 1,150,000 euros. Required or equivalent: OPQIBI 1819 engineering of complex bridges, OPQIBI 1820 structural diagnostics, OPQIBI 0331 construction supervision. In addition, FNTP 1111 highly complex civil engineering structures in concrete and reinforced concrete, FNTP 7253 renewal/repair of expansion joints, FNTP 7276 strengthening with external passive reinforcement, FNTP 7277 strengthening by additional prestressing. References for comparable services and works on road infrastructures with high operational constraints from the last 5 years, with certificates of proper execution. Evidence of academic and professional qualifications of key personnel. Tender phase: ASQPE certifications for prestressing systems or evidence of equivalence.
auftraggeber: ESCOTA SOCIETE DES AUTOROUTES ESTEREL, COTE D'AZUR, PROVENCE, ALPES, Direction de la Maîtrise d'Ouvrage, 432 avenue de Cannes BP41, 06210 Mandelieu-La-Napoule, France. Contact: DMO - Service Marchés et Contrats. E-mail: marches.escota@vinci-autoroutes.com. Telephone: +33493485000. Website: http://www.vinci-autoroutes.com. Procurement platform: https://consultations-escota.omnikles.com
notes: Two-stage negotiated procedure with prior call for competition; at least 3 candidates for the second phase. A maximum of 2 lots can be tendered for, but only 1 lot can be awarded. Lot 1 duration 27 months, Lot 2 duration 40 months. 100 percent financed by ESCOTA. No framework agreement. Social performance clause to promote employment. Tender documents only in French.
